summary: [spec-fidelity] The retags to canon-0-35-crate-cursor.F5 (atip.canoncursor.02 and .04) cover half of F5: canon declares 1.4 and so binds by the 1.2 rules, and .02 (CANON_ROLE and an explicit default bind) and .04 (--all in place of --limit is not bound) prove exactly that half. F5's other half, the same arguments under 1.1 binding --all and ignoring the environment, has no canon-observable form (canon never runs as a 1.1 tool) and stays the crate's own test (atip_cratecursor_03 and 11). Signed because every Then step of both scenarios is proven; recorded so the brief check does not read F5 as proven for 1.1. Blast radius: a canon regression that bound --all or dropped the environment from the binding would fail .02 and .04; a crate regression in the 1.1 rules would not fail anything in canon.
